meta.project: SupeRR Selector Season 2 – RR 2027 War Room
meta.data_status: Static decision-support build. Auction registration list is not yet verified. Refresh when official registered list is published.
meta.private_data_notice: Do not expose or upload raw ball-by-ball source data. All figures below are derived aggregates from the user-owned project ZIP.

website_objective: An editorial-quality Rajasthan Royals squad and auction decision war-room. It must show the fixed retained core, tactical vacant slots, horse-for-courses lineups, the ten pressure-ranked batters and bowlers on separate pages, and a clearly distinguished RR auction target shortlist. It must be evidence-led and never infer availability from release alone. Include the complete 89-player released reference pool transcribed from the user-uploaded release PDF as a searchable market register, while keeping the detailed priority watchlist separate.

rr_analytical_notes.selection_philosophy: Horses for courses: select for role, matchup, venue, batting position, phase and risk; do not rank all candidates on one generic score.

big_game_case_studies.diagnostic: Batting ceiling / collapse resistance case study; not proof of one isolated cause.
Middle-order was pressured by spin after early progress; Dhruv Jurel 56 not out; Shahbaz Ahmed 3/23 and Abhishek Sharma 2/24.
Batting produced 214; chase control/bowling execution failed; Gill 104 off 53, Sudharsan 58 off 32.

bowling_usage_caveats: Trent Boult: project IPL-only role usage readout shows 61.2% powerplay usage and 17.3% death usage. Treat as a new-ball option, not an automatic death-over specialist.
Pathirana: project IPL-only target board shows 302 death legal deliveries across 29 matches, 8.80 economy and 8.55 wickets per 100. Medical clearance is mandatory due 2026 hamstring surgery.
Mustafizur: project IPL-only target board shows 206 death legal deliveries across 21 matches and 10.28 economy; phase flexibility is the differentiator, not equivalence to Pathirana.
Akash Madhwal: project IPL-only target board shows 106 death legal deliveries across 14 matches, 10.30 economy and 6.72 wickets per 100; domestic depth, not proven frontline closer.

Yorker delivery_style counts in the supplied data are usage labels only. They do not measure yorker accuracy, execution success, target-zone hit rate, or miss percentage. UI must say “recorded yorker usage”, never “yorker accuracy”.
P2 general profiles are descriptive IPL+T20I aggregates unless an IPL-only target-board field explicitly states IPL-only. Do not mix scopes silently.
No injury prediction, injury diagnosis or return-to-play forecast is generated. Only cite public reported events and mark medical status as “requires team medical assessment”.
rr_analytical_notes.pricing_logic: No validated auction price model exists. Do not invent expected prices or bid ceilings. Include a manual editable scenario calculator with user-entered base price, rival bidder count and hard ceiling. Label any resulting market scenario as analyst-entered scenario, not prediction. Do not hard-code a predicted Nehal or Mangesh price.
rr_analytical_notes.auction_availability_logic: Released is not equal to registered. All released-player cards must display “registration unverified” until official registered player list is confirmed. The final auction list is not yet public as of 2026-11-18.
rr_analytical_notes.middle_order_target_preference: For a No.4–5 innings-repair / left-handed middle-order requirement, Nehal Wadhera is the preferred role-fit watchlist option over M Shahrukh Khan. This is an analyst fit judgement, not a P1 ranking: Nehal has only 59 pressure-gated balls and is below P1 eligibility. Shahrukh is a better fit only when the specific need is a No.6–7 power hitter.
rr_analytical_notes.ferreira_and_shanaka_slot_logic: Donovan Ferreira is retained and already supplies lower-order hitting. Do not create a vacant finisher role. Shanaka is an optional fourth overseas XI selection only when his batting/bowling contribution improves the specific matchup; do not force an overseas player simply to use the quota. Ferreira, Archer, an overseas pace specialist and Shanaka would consume all four overseas XI slots.
rr_analytical_notes.auction_bid_discipline: No predictive auction valuation exists. The website may let the analyst enter a manual ceiling and 0–3 rival-bidder scenario. Once the ceiling is crossed, highlight the named fallback rather than inventing a forecast price. Nehal price demand is uncertain; if multiple franchises pursue him, use a pre-set walk-away ceiling and switch to verified Indian middle-order alternatives.

market_register_rules.salary_display: Show raw figure as printed in the user PDF with label “source salary field (unit not specified)”; never call it base price or expected auction price.
market_register_rules.new_entrants: Empty pending section until official registered player list is published; do not fabricate names.

rr_recruitment_hypotheses.horses_for_courses: No universal best XI; select matchups by pitch, opponent batting hand, phase, conditions, innings context and medical/workload availability.
rr_recruitment_hypotheses.core_squad: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Riyan Parag, Dhruv Jurel, Donovan Ferreira, Ravindra Jadeja, Jofra Archer, with Bishnoi/Punja/Siddharth and Shami/Burger/Sandeep selected by role.

fallbacks: Shubham Dubey (retained; role overlap lower in order)
Vihaan Malhotra (development only; not ready-made IPL starter)
vacancy_hypotheses_not_commitments.reason: Adds left-handed No.4-5 batting cover; pressure sample below eligibility; recent 2026 output is a risk.
Preserve Indian seam depth and provide options around Archer/Shami/Burger; none should be called proven death elite from supplied evidence.
Boult has strong historical powerplay use but only 2 wickets at 11.63 economy in IPL 2026 and low death usage; only target for new-ball matchup value.
Best pressure model evidence among watchlist bowlers; hamstring surgery recovery is hard acquisition risk.
Middle-over wicket-taking skill but role overlap with Bishnoi/Punja/Jadeja/Siddharth; recent hamstring return requires workload review.
Ferreira/Dubey/Shanaka already cover lower-order roles. Any new finisher must demonstrate distinct marginal value, not just hitting ability.

rr_recruitment_hypotheses.overseas_rule: 5 overseas retained; max 8 in squad means at most 3 overseas additions; max 4 in playing XI. A four-overseas XI must explicitly state who is benched.
rr_recruitment_hypotheses.bid_logic: No modelled hammer-price output. Use manual ceiling, competitor count and walk-away fallback only; printed release-PDF salary values are not auction estimates.
